risks: Patching RTL from the downstream zero-output symptom could modify the wrong module and invalidate reusable lower-layer certification.

Interpreting unequal stage latency as a same-cycle timing failure would contradict the certified elastic pipeline contract.
A direct-boundary signal path must remain bound to the cited current hierarchy; silently guessing a replacement hierarchy name would invalidate the trace.
A board output alone cannot prove complete weight consumption or semantic correctness.
